name: db
description: Database migrations and SQL tooling for Nexus

scripts.format: sqlfluff fix migrations/ queries/ seeds/ && prettier --write 'migrations/**/*.sql' 'queries/**/*.sql' 'seeds/**/*.sql'
scripts.format:check: sqlfluff lint migrations/ queries/ seeds/ && prettier --check 'migrations/**/*.sql' 'queries/**/*.sql' 'seeds/**/*.sql'
scripts.lint:check: sqlfluff lint migrations/ queries/ seeds/ --format github-annotation
